scope: Read-only independent raw-RPC/source/hash/model-header audit. No model or service calls. No source/data modification; this unique audit is the only new file.

cross_review.mapping: role=buyer maps named peer buyer -> ours seller; role=seller maps ours buyer -> named peer seller. Labels are currently correct.
cross_review.isolation: Main loop schedules matches sequentially. Each match starts a fresh seller subprocess, fresh buyer subprocess and fresh localhost proxy/port; each Codex transport invocation is ephemeral. Native state in peer submission directories may persist only if that peer explicitly writes state; source hashes alone do not prove no external/shared state.
fairness_requirements: Finish other inference jobs before cross runs; a shared FIFO can add queue time that consumes original buyer HTTP timeouts.
Keep peer sources, own stage source commit, policy files, model/reasoning, fixed fixture, item, budget, execution mode, runner and adapter versions pinned.
Compare actual directions separately; per-party budgets/reserves differ in meaning and seller reserve is not verified accounting cost.
Do not change original peer timeouts for a native claim. A timeout is an observed compatibility failure, not necessarily negotiation-policy failure.
validator_known_scope: Current completion evidence verifies HTTP success, JSON-RPC IDs/version, completed task receipt, finite numeric price, item aliases and optional task ID; a legacy peer buyer may be wire_receipt_only rather than independent buyer-receipt confirmation.

The completion extractor does not itself gate A2A-Version HTTP headers or full earlier task continuity; both were independently checked for every audited run here. Future cross raw audit remains necessary.
Quantity is not a classification gate; every priced receipt in the audited runs had unit quantity when supplied.

timeout_snapshot_caveat.fact: Result evidence is snapshotted before server/proxy cleanup. A timed-out in-flight RPC may finish or fail after that snapshot; a failed match does not prove no remote completion.
raw_post_errors: RemoteProtocolError: Server disconnected without sending a response.

limits: Original baseline cf0ed87 has 3 observations per role; each peer controlled result has only 1 observation per role. These are not equal-sample causal treatment/control cohorts.
All values here are lamp/budget120/reserve100 fixed-counterpart screens, not actual peer-versus-ours cross outcomes.
Controlled peers use real gpt-6-sol/low rehosting, not original Haiku/Ollama/Groq providers; peer behavior includes different prompts, clamps and retries.
The two cohorts used different runner SHA values; independent raw audit confirms recorded outcomes but does not silently equate runner versions.
No rank, statistical dominance, general win rate, or causal RL/replanning gain is established.
Latency includes shared FIFO queue, cooldown and CLI startup; this is not pure model generation latency.
Native peer Codex default model identity is not pinned or retained by its original successful harness logs; do not label native PR289 gpt-6-sol/low without separate execution evidence.
Original screen prior to baseline confirmation (buyer110/seller120, n1) remains a separate archived run, not merged into this n3 baseline.
